donors.reason: CDK inhibitor; plausible transcriptional CDK inhibition altering H3K27/H3K36 methylation, matching SMER-3 anchor pattern.
DNA synthesis inhibitor causing replication stress; can indirectly alter histone methylation marks, supporting chromatin perturbation.
JAK1/JAK2 ATP-competitive inhibitor; kinase inhibition may indirectly affect chromatin modifier activity and histone marks.

revised_hypotheses: SMER-3 may inhibit CDKs, reducing RNA Pol II phosphorylation and altering H3K27/H3K36 methylation; supported by roscovitine CDK inhibitor description.
SMER-3 may cause replication stress via DNA synthesis inhibition, indirectly changing histone marks; supported by etoposide DNA synthesis inhibitor description.
SMER-3 may inhibit JAK/STAT signaling, indirectly affecting chromatin modifiers; supported by momelotinib JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor description.
unresolved: No retrieved source describes SMER-3 mechanism; PubChem only calls it an aromatic ketone.
KU-55933 and resveratrol had no retrieved descriptions, so their mechanistic support is unresolved.
